usage: TextOS is used strictly as a tool by ShortsOS. The ShortsOS drivers under scripts/textos/** import TextOS modules from a separate, pinned, read-only checkout; nothing is ever written into that checkout and nothing is ever committed or pushed to a TextOS repository. scripts/textos/run.ts refuses to start unless the checkout sits at exactly the SHA pinned for that step with a clean working tree, and re-checks the tree is still clean after the step.

writer.why: Integration tip of the latest TextOS article line: the CTC intake seam (ctc-geo-writer-adapter@0.1), the geo-writer with per-slot statement-id namespacing (geo-writer@0.2), grounded tracked-brand subjects, the public editorial voice (geo-writer-slot@0.3 prompt), governed evidence approval and human public-use clearance, and the promoted content-surface core (ContentDocument@1 bridge, surface resolution, headless JSON adapter). Site Intelligence (crawl + extraction) is run from this same checkout.

clientFlow.why: Latest TextOS client flow (the PA client line): operator question proposals with canonical intent / buyerStage / commercialIntent metadata, human approval before any measurement, and the rule that no article is proposed before a measured opportunity exists. ShortsOS follows that flow as a client; this ref is referenced for the proposal contract only and is not executed here.

surfacePolish.why: CMO surface polish of the content-surface engine, not merged into any trunk at this ref. Two generic parts are used: the A2R render-parity oracle (exported HTML against each document's semantic tree) and the derived conversion plan with its related-content ranking. The commercial capability is always passed as "unconfigured", so no commercial CTA, and none of the campaign copy that module carries, can come out of it: only the editorial next step.
